description: Plan diverse road-following fiber lead-in routes from a site to a carrier hotel or POP, with distances, indicative build cost and shared-corridor points.

bore_m.description: River/rail bore length in metres to add to the route, 0-100000 (optional)

fibre.description: Fibre count spec for cost estimate: "720F" or "1440F"

from.description: Origin site as "lat,lng" OR a street address, e.g. "250 Paringa Road, Murarrie QLD"

n.description: Number of diverse routes to plan, 1-6 (default 4)

to.description: Destination carrier hotel/POP as "lat,lng" OR an address, e.g. "20 Wharf Street, Brisbane City QLD"

name: plan_fiber_leadin
title: Plan Fiber Leadin
